note: The levels of proof a test can have that its check works, ordered by rank (higher rank = stronger). Closed variety lives here and code reads it (FR-13). D-0010: every NEW or CHANGED test instance gets the live check (probe_by_code.py); D-0012: an unchanged, reused test is not probed and blocks nothing; the product level (red_sandbox.py --probe) is a rare exception on the code critic's doubt that the check looks at the product. Only a failed or absent live check blocks delivery. A receipt of a higher level satisfies a lower level's requirement. A receipt counts for the bytes its test holds now, or with the code of the test unchanged (D-0017: a comment-only change, diff_scope.executable_sha equal; FB-10: an added test function). The S5 window (acceptance.validate_window) binds a review and a probe by the same rule, per test instance (proof_level.same_test). `scripts/proof_level.py` is the one reader.

levels.meaning: its assertion runs and fails when made false
a deliberate break of the product made it fail

unknown_words: proof level unknown (the test file cannot be found)
comment_only_words: the receipt holds over a comment-only change
code_unchanged_words: the receipt holds: the test's code is the same as when it was proven

review_words.approved_with_fixes: reviewed by the code critic, fixes named
review_words.unverified: the code critic could not verify it
